p: for this: For he thought it unworthy of his estate to receive a benefit and not reward it.
hang Mordecai on the gallows that: Thus while the wicked imagine the destruction of others, they themselves fall into the same pit.
horse that the king rideth upon: Meaning by this that the king should make him next to himself as Joseph was known to be next to Pharaoh in Ge 41:43.
but shalt surely fall before him: Thus God sometimes puts in the mouth of the very wicked to speak that thing which he has decreed shall come to pass.
